orchestrator.purpose: The Model is the orchestrating center of the POD (docs/POD_ARCHITECTURE.md sec1): it takes the Prism-screened input, decides what the situation needs, reads the Orbs' records for grounding, and coordinates the response. StoreApp/Orchestrator.cs is NOT that intelligence - it is the deterministic execution boundary (sec6): the rails the Model orchestrates within. It owns phase/session state and the safety preconditions (valid SystemAudit before anything reaches the model/consent/repair; Action-Envelope admissibility; consent-before-repair) and holds no diagnostic or repair logic of its own. It HOLDS the action envelope (owned/authored by the Computer Technician Orb) and KEYS the repair-plan Umbilical to it: at scan->plan it compiles the per-machine admissible action set (preconditions x diagnostics) and hands it to the model author; at plan->consent the keyed envelope is the guard; at consent it renders risk / requires_restart / estimated_mb from the envelope, not from model output - so every sign the user approves has a real referent.

architecture.summary: The Educated Model is the orchestrating center; Orbs & Satellites give it its abilities. Two Orbs frame the product: the Computer Technician Orb (no client channel; scans, authors the plan, PUBLISHES its findings) and the Communications & Governance Orb (the Prism front door - PIM->IRG->RBC->IDS, bidirectional; READS this session's findings to ground the Custodian). They are joined by the append-only findings relay - a record, not a live channel - which is why both run on a single model.

orbs.purpose: Diagnose and act on the PC. Repair knowledge (the Tech Library, formed into the model) + the repair engine + the Action Envelope; scans against the validated SystemAudit, authors the plan on-device, and publishes envelope-admissible findings. Has NO client channel.

Communicate under governance. The Prism on a Portal (PIM->IRG->RBC->IDS, bidirectional) - the front door for all customer conversation; reads this session's authorized findings to ground the Custodian, then governs every inbound and outbound turn. Observe, never judge; where a message does not resonate the way forward is an IDS reroute, never a deny.

architecture.relay_seam: StoreApp/FindingsRelayIntegration.cs + StoreApp/Governance/AppendOnlyFindingsRelay.cs (TOTEM-C-0112). Technician PUBLISHES (MainWindow.PublishFindingsToRelay: valid SystemAudit + each action Action-Envelope-admissible + record bound to the audit's own EvidenceHash); Comms & Governance READS (ComposeCommsSeed -> ReadAuthorizedFindings: session-boundary authorized, held==requested==token). A caller cannot read another session's findings.
architecture.gate: PipelineGovernance(enabled:false) in StoreApp/MainWindow.xaml.cs - the section-8 admission gate is CLOSED: OfferingAllowed is false, TechnicianEntry is hidden, ScreenInbound refuses every inbound, and the on-device model is never constructed in a shipped build. The conversation is code-complete and wired; opening it is a deliberate section-8 decision (new PipelineGovernance(enabled:true, canon:<shipped ref>)) that also requires the exact Canon provisioned on the machine.
